title: Independent zero-network audit of GMGN query transport and diagnostics repair
objective: Independently audit GMGN-PORTFOLIO-QUERY-TRANSPORT-DIAGNOSTICS-REPAIR-001 using a distinct HARNESS_AGENT_ID and zero network/provider requests. Verify that API-key-only 7d/30d stats use bounded multi-wallet CLI invocations, stats mode never forwards GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY, both API-key-only and signed child environments use disposable HOME/CWD, IPv4-first DNS, disabled CLI rate-limit auto retry, and a 30000ms process ceiling. Verify malformed signed-key material is rejected locally before spawn, raw child/provider text is reduced to allowlisted safe codes and is not retained, external records preserve null-for-missing plus source=gmgn and verificationStatus=unverified, and the corrected historical live-smoke report distinguishes activation baseline, delivery commit, CLI invocation count, and physical-request upper bound. This audit must not claim live availability; a separate exact-budget live diagnostic is required after GREEN.
forbidden_actions: Do not invoke GMGN, Helius, Chain.fm, Dune, Dexscreener, Birdeye, RPC, a browser, web scraping, or any network provider.

Do not inspect, display, retain, or test against credential values, external address files, plaintext addresses, labels, raw payloads, raw stdout/stderr, complete exceptions, signatures, or credential URLs.
Do not modify application code, tests, package manifests, implementer evidence, historical normalized outputs, or external files.
Do not authorize or run a live diagnostic unless this audit is GREEN and a separate exact-budget task spec and dispatch exist.
